reviews.reviewText:
* Software Process Models (Waterfall, Agile, Spiral, Iterative)
* Requirements Engineering (elicitation techniques, SRS templates)
* Software Project Metrics & Estimation Techniques (COCOMO, LOC, Function Points)
* Risk Analysis & Risk Management (identification methods, mitigation strategies)
* Project Scheduling & Tracking (Gantt, PERT/CPM, earned value)
* Software Quality Assurance (reviews, testing levels, QA standards like ISO)
* Software Re-engineering (reverse-engineering, refactoring, legacy systems)
* Change Control & Configuration Management (version control tools, baseline concepts)
* Maintenance Types & Models (corrective, adaptive, preventive, perfective)
* Software Design Documentation & Process Quality Audits
